info.title: Work Master API
info.description: Implemented Phase 1 authentication and Phase 2 authorized reads. Public invoice and payment mutations remain planned. Production requires HTTPS; see docs/api/README.md. Phase 4 adds draft creation, separate submission and one-invoice receipts with required idempotency keys. Existing website pricing and posting rules remain unchanged.

item_code.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

unit_price.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding applies.

discount_amount.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding applies.

tax_amount.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding applies.

non_system_invoice.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

InvoiceCreate.description: Creates a draft without receipts or stock reservation. All lines use the required header warehouse. Names and snapshots come from current master records. UGX rates/amounts follow existing whole-unit rounding; quantities retain three decimals. Omitting posting_time uses server Kampala time when first committed; retries retain the original result.

amount.description: Positive decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding must leave a positive receipt. Amount cannot exceed the current balance including qualifying journal allocations.

account_id.description: Positive safe-integer string. Active permitted asset Cash/Bank account; method is derived by existing posting.

external_source.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

external_reference.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

notes.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

PaymentCreate.description: One submitted invoice per receipt. Source/reference permanently protects this account independently of credential rotation, ordinary key expiry or website cancellation. No new uniqueness rule on website payments.

PaymentMutationResult.description: Original receipt and parent database IDs. Read invoice/payment endpoints for current status and amounts; cancellation never reactivates a receipt.

ApiError.description: Error envelope; status determines category. Retry-After required for throttling; never expose SQL errors or stack traces.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one header, 1–128 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Stable account/operation/resource key. Identical validated payload replays original committed status/body for seven days; changed payload conflicts. Current authorization is rechecked. Failed pre-commit validation or posting does not consume the key. Reconcile draft creation after expiry. Permanent payment references survive expiry.
